rootCause.statement: Incremental schema changes must be applied through an inspected, replayable migration boundary. Duplicate columns are a no-op only when PRAGMA confirms the column exists; unrelated SQL failures must abort initialization instead of being logged and reported as success.

semanticLocations: DatabaseMigrations.kt:96-100 performs a version-bounded book_sources ALTER TABLE
BookSource.kt:27-41 defines the persistent book_sources identity and type fields

affectedSourceSet.sourcePackageScope: all imported Legado source records and compatibility tables
affectedSourceSet.sourceSetBinding: all records are bound by the frozen package hash; no raw source payload is persisted in this evidence

scenarios.given: PRAGMA table_info reports the target column
scenarios.expected: skip ALTER TABLE and emit no duplicate-column error

scenarios.given: PRAGMA table_info does not report the target column
scenarios.expected: execute one ADD COLUMN with the declared default

scenarios.given: the process restarts after a migration version completes
scenarios.expected: resume at the next version without replaying completed destructive work

scenarios.given: a non-idempotent migration statement fails for a reason other than an existing column
scenarios.expected: abort initialization and expose a blocked database state

scenarios.given: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS fails because its table or column is unavailable
scenarios.expected: propagate the schema failure and do not advance database initialization

scenarios.given: PRAGMA user_version cannot be queried or returns no row
scenarios.expected: close the result set when available, propagate the failure, and do not restart migration from version 0

scenarios.given: loading persisted source JSON or V2 compatibility records fails after the database opens
scenarios.expected: propagate the failure to NovelInitializer and keep sourceManagerInitialized false instead of reporting a usable module

scenarios.given: an existing database contains source, book, chapter or reader data
scenarios.expected: migration does not drop those tables or silently report success

closeCondition: Static contract passes against current HEAD, all eight scenarios are represented, DatabaseManager, NovelDataManager and NovelInitializer propagate genuine migration failures, and a later build/device cold-start gate confirms no duplicate-column error. Runtime/build/device closure remains separate from this source contract.
